description: This file defines TypeScript types and utility functions related to legacy configuration rules, migrations, and data transformations within a software project. It includes type definitions for rules, migrations, and their specifications, as well as utility functions for manipulating and validating configuration-related data structures.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Safely retrieves a record object from a value if it is a record, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: ensureRecord
methods.description: Ensures that a given key in a root record points to a record object, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: mergeMissing
methods.description: Recursively merges properties from a source record into a target record, skipping undefined values and blocked keys.

methods.name: mapLegacyAudioTranscription
methods.description: Transforms a legacy transcription object, validating command structure and safety, into a standardized record.

methods.name: getAgentsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of agents from a given agents record, returning an empty array if invalid.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentIdFromRaw
methods.description: Resolves the default agent ID from raw configuration, falling back to various defaults, or 'main'.

methods.name: ensureAgentEntry
methods.description: Ensures an agent entry with a specific ID exists in a list, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: defineLegacyConfigMigration
methods.description: Defines or returns the given legacy configuration migration object.
